description: Reviewable workspace discovery and private HTML review creation via stdio MCP.
name: io.github.garrietv/reviewable-artifacts

environmentVariables.description: Optional advanced HTTPS origin override for self-hosted, staging, loopback, or a reachable interim service when the canonical domain is blocked.
environmentVariables.name: REVIEWABLE_MCP_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Advanced compatibility credential for workspace reads and private-review creation. It takes precedence over a stored browser grant; keep it local and do not combine it with reviewer share URLs.
environmentVariables.name: REVIEWABLE_MCP_WORKSPACE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Advanced least-privilege credential: one or more reviewer share URLs for read-only access to those reviews. Takes precedence over a stored browser grant; owner links are rejected.
environmentVariables.name: REVIEWABLE_MCP_REVIEWS
